program_name: Bachelor of Engineering (Hons.) Electronics majoring in Computer

requirements.general_text: Entry Requirements Applicants must meet one of the following criteria: Foundation/Matriculation: Pass in a related field from a recognised institution. STPM or equivalent: Minimum Grade C (GP 2.00) in Mathematics and Physics. A-Level: Minimum Grade D in Mathematics and Physics. UEC: Minimum Grade B in at least five (5) subjects, including Mathematics and Physics. Diploma: Recognised Diploma in Engineering/Engineering Technology or equivalent with a minimum CGPA of 2.00. DKM/DLKM/DVM: Minimum CGPA of 2.50. Candidates with CGPA below 2.50 must have at least two (2) years of relevant work experience.* APEL.A Certificate: Possession of an APEL.A certificate from MQA for admission into Bachelor programmes.  Note: DKM/DLKM/DVM candidates may be required to undergo a Bridging Programme as an additional requirement.
